headline: Back to Build volume on the nose; night work still owed
narrative: First full week back after the deload and the vert landed almost exactly on target, with time on feet right on its ask too. Read it honestly, though: a big slice of the climbing came from Tuesday's ascent-only treadmill session at 15% — machine vert, no descent load. The real test was the weekend: Saturday's parkrun rolling straight into the Doctor's Gate fell race route over Higher Shelf Stones and James's Thorn, then a sociable Sunday outing over Lantern Pike. That's genuine descending on consecutive days, and the right quad came through it without a murmur — no flags all week, with Wednesday and Thursday held to gym-only while the strength programme beds in.

The one miss: this week was meant to open night-running practice and a fuelling rehearsal, and nothing in the log shows either. That box stays unticked and needs a slot soon — the Peak-phase night back-to-back assumes the practice is banked. Cumulatively, Costa Blanca stays on schedule. Next week is the biggest ask of the build so far: a proper big back-to-back plus the first course recon segment.
